_help: Fixes for managing agent names in BCA's data. Names are compared after removing Pte/Ltd, punctuation and case, and expanding MGT/MGMT to MANAGEMENT. 'merge' maps one firm to another (renames, odd spellings). 'display' sets the name shown on the site. 'notFirm' lists values that aren't a managing agent. Run npm run build-data to see possible duplicates.
